Privacy Policy

This app is run by the Management Committee of Trinayan Nivas Housing Society for its residents only.

What we store

Your name, email address, flat number, and anything you choose to add: phone number, household members, vehicle details, posts, comments, photos and buy/sell listings. For each flat we also store maintenance dues and payments.

Who can see it

Other logged-in residents can see your name, flat, posts and listings, and your phone number unless you turn on "Hide my phone number". Dues are visible only to your flat and the Management Committee. Society accounts are visible only to the Management Committee.

Where it is kept

Data is stored with Supabase, a cloud database provider. We do not sell or share your data, and the app has no ads or tracking.

Deleting your data

You can delete your account at any time from My Unit → My Profile → Delete my account, or by asking the Management Committee.
